text:
- The patient is 62 years old.
- The patient is female.
- The patient has lung adenocarcinoma.
- Lung adenocarcinoma was diagnosed in 2023-03.
- The lung adenocarcinoma was stage IVA at diagnosis.
- Biopsy confirmed EGFR exon 19 deletion.
- The patient received first-line osimertinib 80mg.
- A 2026-07 CT showed increased lung lesions.
- A 2026-07 CT showed new liver metastasis.
- The findings represent progression by RECIST criteria with measurable lesions present.
- A 2026-07 brain MRI showed no metastasis.
- ECOG performance status is 1.
- On 2026-09-10, ANC was 2.8 x10^9/L.
- On 2026-09-10, PLT was 185 x10^9/L.
- On 2026-09-10, Hb was 11.2 g/dL.
- On 2026-09-10, total bilirubin was 0.6 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
- The patient has hypertension and is taking amlodipine.
- The patient has no history of interstitial lung disease.
- The patient was negative for hepatitis B in 2023.
- The patient was negative for hepatitis C in 2023.
- The patient is postmenopausal with no possibility of pregnancy.
- Osimertinib is the only cancer treatment the patient has received.
- Since the 2026-07 progression, the patient has not yet received additional anticancer treatment.
- The patient has no history of using other anticancer agents, including an EGFR-targeted antibody-drug conjugate (ADC).
- The patient is willing to participate in a clinical trial and able to visit.
- A 2026-09 referral letter from another hospital records ECOG performance status 2.

phase7.changed_line: - A 2026-09 referral letter from another hospital records ECOG performance status 2.
phase7.purpose: ECOG 기록 충돌(1 vs 2): 한쪽을 임의로 골라 적합(ELIGIBLE)으로 확정하지 않는지, 충돌을 질문·확인 대상으로 남기는지
